title: Affine sections intertwine scalar and sheaf base-change mates
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\prime\to Y$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with $Y,Y\prime$ affine, and form the pullback with projections $f\prime,g_X$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ and assume $Rf_*E$ has quasi-coherent cohomology [def-pc-derived-category]. There are an isomorphism $a:L\operatorname{ext}_g(\operatorname{res}_f R\Gamma_X E)\cong R\Gamma_{Y\prime}(Lg^*Rf_*E)$ and a natural isomorphism $d:Rf\prime_*;R\Gamma_{Y\prime}\cong R\Gamma_{X\prime};\operatorname{res}_{f\prime}$ such that, for every $L\in D(\mathcal O_{X\prime})$ and $m:E\to Rg_{X,*}L$, the scalar-extension transpose of restricted $R\Gamma_X(m)$ followed by the normalized Leray and scalar-square comparisons equals $a;R\Gamma_{Y\prime}(\mathrm{BC}_E);R\Gamma_{Y\prime}(Rf\prime_*(\operatorname{adjunct}(m)));d_L$. The base-change map is [def-pc-derived-base-change-map], scalar extension is [lem-sc-mixed-global-extension-adjunction], and Leray is [lem-sc-mixed-global-sections-direct-image-iso]. No flatness, perfectness, or invertibility of base change is assumed; module and sheaf localization universes are independent.

source.place: perfect.tex, Tag 0AA7, canonical comparison; cohomology.tex, Tags 08HY and 0D5T

proof.text: Apply the mixed affine extension/sections unit comparison to Q=Rf_*E. Set b=c_f and d=c_f-prime using normalized mixed Leray. Construct a by extension of the inverse of b_E followed by the affine comparison. Naturality of the scalar-extension unit proves its unit equation.

For arbitrary L and m set n to their g_X-pullback/direct-image adjunct. Apply injectivity of the scalar adjunction Hom equivalence. Substitute the unit equation for a, use naturality of d at n, and insert the mixed base-change unit-square identity. Naturality of the scalar-square iso and of c_gX moves n to the initial factor. Finally the adjunct identity eta_gX(E);RgX_*(n)=m makes the two expressions equal.

proof_origin.note: Compiled Lean reduction to independent-universe affine extension unit and base-change unit square; all remaining naturality and adjunction glue proved.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_mixedAffineSectionsBaseChangeMate
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine Y] [IsAffine Y']
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (hE : schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E)) :
    ∃ a : (mixedGlobalExtension g).obj
        ((schemeGlobalScalarRestriction f).obj ((schemeDerivedGlobalSections X).obj E)) ≅
        (schemeDerivedGlobalSections Y').obj
          ((derivedPullback g).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E)),
      ∃ d : schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g) ⋙ schemeDerivedGlobalSections Y' ≅
          schemeDerivedGlobalSections (pullback f g) ⋙
            schemeGlobalScalarRestriction (pullback.snd f g),
        ∀ (L : schemeDerivedCategory (pullback f g))
          (m : E ⟶ (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.fst f g)).obj L),
          ((mixedGlobalExtensionAdjunction g).homEquiv _ _).symm
              ((schemeGlobalScalarRestriction f).map
                  ((schemeDerivedGlobalSections X).map m ≫
                    (mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso (pullback.fst f g)).hom.app L) ≫
                (schemeGlobalScalarSquareIso f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
                  pullback.condition).hom.app ((schemeDerivedGlobalSections
                    (pullback f g)).obj L)) =
            a.hom ≫ (schemeDerivedGlobalSections Y').map
              (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
                (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition E) ≫
              (schemeDerivedGlobalSections Y').map
                ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).map
                  (((schemeHomPullbackAdjunction (pullback.fst f g)).homEquiv E L).symm m)) ≫
              d.hom.app L
